extDescription.message: Move around the Atmosphere with ease — switch between clients, auto-redirect to your client of choice, and copy universal links.

popup_unsupported.message: This page isn't an atproto link.

popup_noDataTitle.message: No Atmosphere data on this page

popup_noDataBody.message: We couldn't find a supported AT URI for this tab (from the address or an at:// link in the page head). Your destinations below open each app's home page. On a supported profile or post, this popup will offer context-aware links instead.

popup_noDestinations.message: No destinations are visible. Add waypoints to a group in Settings.

popup_shortcutsHint.message: Shortcuts open each app's home page

about_lede.message: Aturi makes Atmosphere links shareable with anyone. Drop a person an Aturi link and they pick the client they prefer — Bluesky, Anisota, Leaflet, Red Dwarf, and more — instead of being locked into yours.

about_aturiSub.message: Fast travel across the Atmosphere. The web app and this extension are part of the same project — the extension is a quick way to jump between Atmosphere clients while you browse.

about_peopleSub.message: Aturi is built by Dame and stewarded under the @$STEWARD$ umbrella on the Atmosphere — give them a follow for updates, releases, and the occasional bug fight.

about_feedbackSub.message: Found a bug, want to suggest a new waypoint, or have an idea for the popup? File an issue or open a pull request on Tangled — Aturi is open source under GPL v3.

defaults_lede.message: Tune how the popup behaves and, when auto-redirect is on, pick a favorite reader for each family of records. Redirects only apply between clients that share the same underlying data.

defaults_appearanceSub.message: Pick a color theme and text size. Changes apply immediately to the popup and this settings page.

defaults_autoRedirectOnSub.message: On — pick a favorite reader for each record family below.

defaults_autoRedirectOffSub.message: Off — the popup still works, but nothing is redirected automatically.

defaults_favoritesHelp.message: Each group holds apps that render the same underlying records, so redirects between them make sense. Pick a favorite (or leave blank) for each.

defaults_favoritesEmpty.message: Add more waypoints to your groups in the Waypoints tab to configure favorites here.

defaults_smartRecsOnSub.message: The popup highlights a "Recommended" row tailored to the current record (e.g. Standard Site pages suggest Leaflet, Offprint, pckt).

defaults_smartRecsOffSub.message: Off — the popup only shows your defined groups in the order you set, with no extra recommendation row.

defaults_openNewTabOnSub.message: Picking a waypoint opens it in a new browser tab.

defaults_openNewTabOffSub.message: Off — picking a waypoint navigates the current tab instead of opening a new one.

defaults_compactOnSub.message: On — the popup uses a denser layout with smaller icons and no description line, so more waypoints fit at once.

defaults_compactOffSub.message: Off — the popup shows each waypoint with a larger icon and a secondary description line.

defaults_recentsOnSub.message: On — the popup shows a Recents row at the top with the waypoints you reach for most often.

defaults_recentsOffSub.message: Off — the popup hides the Recents row and stops recording new picks.

defaults_clearRecentsConfirm.message: Clear your Recents list? This only affects the Recents row in the popup.
